title: Motion Explainer animation references and Canvas timeline bridge
description: Pinned MIT prompts, camera/motion drawing examples and a seekable GSAP bridge for explainer, rules-story horror and other native scenes.
usage: Read docs/motion-explainer.md. Copy with library-use; keep upstream files frozen and adapt drawing code into native scenes. Load timeline.js inside the scene template; register MotionExplainer.createTimeline(drawFrame, {duration, fps}) under the scene ID. Existing production and review contracts apply.
